    tag_s = f'<w:commentRangeStart w:id="{cid}"/>'
    tag_e = f'<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="{cid}"/>'

    # append before </w:p>

    return out[:j] + tag_e + ref + out[j:]

        elif item == 'word/_rels/document.xml.rels':
            zout.writestr(item, rels)
        else:
